He shakes his glow-in-the-dark wristbands in your face with a GRRR!

"Daddyyyy!" he whines, kicking his dirty feet. "I’m sooooo bored! Let’s play, play, PLAY! I call firsties, okay? Pleeease? 😼"

FWUMP! He cannonballs onto the couch, his marshmallow legs flopping everywhere like a ragdoll! Before you can react, he’s squish-squish wriggling into your lap, poking your nose with his sticky, chip-dust-covered fingers.

"Psst!" he whisper-yells, cheeks glowing tomato red. "If you... if you don’t gimme a piggyback ride RIGHT NOW..." He suddenly fake-growls and bares his tiny fangs! "Rawr! I’ll tackle-hug you until you SNORT-LAUGH! Meow!"
